test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: 10 men can complete a work in 30 days. How many men can complete (1/2) part of the same work in 15 days?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work capacity = 10 men × 30 days = 300 units.

Required work = 1/2 of 300 = 150 units.

Number of men = Required work ÷ Days = 150 ÷ 15 = 10 men.

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

M₁ = 10 men

D₁ = 30 days

W₁ = 1 (Full work)

D₂ = 15 days

W₂ = 1/2 (Half work)

**Formula Used:**

(M₁ × D₁) ÷ W₁ = (M₂ × D₂) ÷ W₂

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Case
 Time (D)
 Work (W)
 Men (M)
 
 

 Initial
 30
 1

 Final
 15
 0.5
 M₂
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ (10 × 30) ÷ 1 = (M₂ × 15) ÷ (1/2)

⇒ 300 = M₂ × 15 × 2

⇒ 300 = M₂ × 30

⇒ M₂ = 300 ÷ 30

⇒ M₂ = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Chain Rule Concept

The relationship between men, days, hours, and work is given by (M₁D₁H₁)/W₁ = (M₂D₂H₂)/W₂.

Direct and Inverse Proportion

Men and Days are inversely proportional (more men, fewer days), while Men and Work are directly proportional (more men, more work).

Efficiency Factor

If the efficiency (E) of workers is different, the formula becomes (M₁D₁E₁)/W₁ = (M₂D₂E₂)/W₂.
